rationale: AAVS1_site_10 is the only candidate whose GUIDE-seq profile is a single genomic site: exactly one detected cleavage site in the entire table, at distance 0 (perfect protospacer match) in AAVS1 on chr19. Every other candidate carries 4-121 additional off-target sites.

method.source_nature: GUIDE-seq output table: one row per detected cleavage site, with distance = mismatches to the target protospacer (0 = on-target) and run = sequencing run
method.metric: number of detected sites per guide, split by distance == 0 vs distance > 0
verification: Column D (name) read in full and AAVS1_site_10 confirmed to occur exactly once across all 1702 data rows
Row 13 read directly and confirmed to be distance 0 at chr19:55116263-55116285

limitations.detail: SRX8228066-69 could not be retrieved: this environment's network egress proxy blocks www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov, eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov and the EBI/ENA mirror www.ebi.ac.uk. The guideseq pipeline also requires sra-tools and bwa (not installed) plus a BWA-indexed human reference. The conclusion therefore rests on the published GUIDE-seq site calls in the supplementary table rather than on a re-run of the pipeline over the raw reads.
limitations.read_counts_unavailable: The sheet carries no read-count column, so 'efficiently' is assessed as detection of the on-target site with no off-target sites, not as on-target read depth.
limitations.single_run_caveat: AAVS1_site_10 is reported in run 3 only, so its zero off-target count rests on one run rather than replicate runs.
